sources.feed_summary: The MoonSwatch Silver Snowflake features a unique engraved snowflake on every watch and can only be bought when it’s snowing in Switzerland The post The Swatch x Omega MoonSwatch Mission to Earthphase – Silver Snowflake puts the weather in charge appeared first on Time+Tide Watches.

issues.problem: Filler 'our take' that adds no new fact. It also repeats the snow rule and the travel advice from the caption.
issues.change: Replace with headline 'Glows under UV' and body 'Swiss snow details glow lime green; Earth phase glows blue.' Change the eyebrow to 'DETAILS'. Both facts are from Time+Tide.

verdict.reason: The facts match Time+Tide (£350, 27 Nov, snow-only sales through 20 March 2027, SSX01B701), the check passes, and the all-black Swatch photo is credited. The rule slide, the 'our take' slide and the launch date repeat things already said, so I've listed swaps for new facts. These are minor, so they can go out without a second review.
